title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are looking for an Accounts Assistant to join our client in Harpenden on a permanent basis.

The role gives you exposure to a number of aspects of accounts but experience of working in these areas in essential.

You must possess strong Xero knowledge and have good Microsoft Excel skills. This role is for someone who has an excellent eye for detail and who enjoys working as an allrounder. Your day to day duties include purchase and sales ledger, credit control and handling expense claims. You will enjoy working in a busy office environment and want to work for a growing organisation.

You are expected to have formalised accounting qualifications.

In return the company offer a salary of up to 32000pa and associated benefits.

The role is offered hybrid:

2 days from home (after training period)

3 days office

The organisation continues to expand so if you want to be part of a growing team then apply now. This is an immediate opportunity.

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Daniel Robinson & Sons Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Bishop s Stortford, Hertfordshire
Salary: £27,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience
Contract: Full-time, permanent Office-based Five days per week

About the role

Are you an ambitious, organised and forward-thinking individual with a keen eye for detail Do you enjoy working with numbers, supporting a busy finance team and contributing to the success of a growing business
Daniel Robinson & Sons is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant / Administrator to join our finance team at our Bishop s Stortford office.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you'll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the Accounts Department, ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts experience who is looking to develop their skills and make a valuable contribution to a growing business.

You'll need a good understanding of financial processes, strong IT skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

Key responsibilities
- Accounts Receivable: Prepare and issue sales invoices, ensuring they are processed accurately and on time.
- Accounts Payable: Process supplier invoices and ensure payments are made within agreed deadlines.
- Bank Reconciliations: Reconcile company bank accounts and investigate any discrepancies.
- Client Payments: Process and handle customer payments both over the telephone and face-to-face.
- Balance Sheet Reconciliations: Assist with balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date.
- Petty Cash and Company Credit Cards: Maintain petty cash records and process company credit card transactions.
- Fixed Assets: Assist with maintaining fixed asset registers and recording relevant transactions.
- Financial Data and Reporting: Work with large datasets, maintain accurate financial records and prepare reports as required.
- General Accounts Administration: Provide day-to-day administrative support to the finance team and assist with other finance-related duties as required.

About you

To be successful in this role, you'll be organised, proactive and comfortable working in a busy environment where accuracy and attention to detail are essential.

Essential skills and experience:
- AAT Level 2 qualification.
- Previous and recent experience in a similar Accounts Assistant or Accounts Administrator role.
- Strong IT and computer skills, with the ability to work confidently with financial data and spreadsheets.
- A good understanding of accounting processes, including sales and purchase ledger activities and reconciliations.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- A professional approach to handling confidential and sensitive financial information.
- The ability to manage your workload, prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- A positive, flexible and team-oriented attitude, with the ability to work independently when required.

What we offer
- Competitive salary of £27,000 £30,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- The opportunity to join a busy and growing business.
- A varied role with exposure to a broad range of finance and accounting activities.
- The opportunity to contribute to the continued success and development of the business.

How to apply

If you have the skills and experience we're looking for and would like to join our team, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your up-to-date CV along with a covering letter explaining why you are suitable for the role.

No agencies, please.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Reporting to an experienced and very personable FC, in a thriving manufacturing and distribution company, this role will entail:
- Taking full ownership of all purchase ledger including processing invoices, dealing with queries and making payments by BACS
- Responsibility for sales ledger including posting cash and issuing invoices
- Credit Control including chasing debt by phone email and providing monthly cashflow updates
- Supplier statement and bank reconciliations
- Assisting the Financial Controller with month end financial tasks
- Ad hoc tasks when required

This role will suit someone with experience in day to day finance, or with a transactional finance background looking to broaden your skills. On offer is a competitive salary, 25 days holiday (plus bank hols).

title: BUSINESS SUPPORT/BOOKKEEPER
description:
Security Trade Products Ltd distribute access control security products, selling mainly to distributors and trade installers.

Based at the headquarters in Meldreth, Royston, STP are looking to recruit a positive, highly organised and proactive Business Manager/Bookkeeper to manage the financial and HR aspects of the business and provide business support to the Director.

What the role would involve:

Finance
- Manage all aspects of Finance administration, maintaining accurate financial records using Sage and Xero accounting software
- Complete all credit control functions, issuing sales invoices, statements and resolving any resulting queries to ensure timely payments are received
- Process accounts payable transactions accurately and consistently, matching purchase invoices with orders and completing both UK and foreign supplier payments as required
- Reconcile bank statements
- Submitting VAT returns
- Support budgeting, sales reporting and day to day financial processes
- Prepare financial reports on a variety of areas including management accounts, cashflow, daily and monthly customer sales, purchasing and stock levels
- Complete month-end and year-end processes and liaise with external accountants during audits and financial reviews

HR
- Manage all aspects of HR administration including supporting with recruitment, holding interviews, conducting pre-employment checks, and issuing employment contracts.
- Establish company policies including Heath & Safety, Absence, use of company equipment including IT, Mobile devices and vehicles.
- Support the Director with appraisals, performance and absence management, including leading in organising and supporting investigation, disciplinary and grievance meetings as and when necessary.
- Maintain an effective and efficient filing system for all related paperwork ensuring there is a consistent audit trail
- Manage and maintain records relating to staff holiday, sickness and expenses
- Prepare payroll data for processing by external agency

Business Support
- Provide business support to the Director, including:
- assisting with both sales and purchase contract negotiations
- providing base information as needed to support the development of customer relations and sales, such as tracking sales against rebate levels
- maintaining consignment data to accurately record stock held at customer locations
- dealing with any other business issues arising as required.

It is essential that the postholder takes pride in doing things properly, is efficient, accurate and organised and is comfortable working in an environment where people work as a team. We are looking for someone with a friendly, professional manner and excellent communication skills who is able to prioritise a busy workload and take ownership without needing constant direction.

Strong oral and written English skills, good numeracy skills and confidence using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, are essential. Previous experience with invoicing, bookkeeping and VAT is important, while knowledge of Sage and Xero is advantageous.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who takes pride in their work and is passionate about delivering a high-quality, professional service.

This is a key role within the business, with particular focus on HR and Finance, so previous experience in both areas is essential. If you are a capable, enthusiastic and highly efficient individual who enjoys working with people and takes pride in making things run smoothly, we would love to hear from you.

This is an office based role, and therefore remote working is not available for this position.
- Full time, permanent, site based 5 days a week
- 36.25 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8.45am - 5pm

title: Credit Controller
description:
We are currently working with a professional services business based in Hertford looking for an experienced Credit Controller to join its finance function. This role will take ownership of outstanding client debt, playing an important part in maintaining cash flow and improving debtor performance across the business. You will be responsible for managing aged debt, producing financial reports and working closely with internal stakeholders to resolve account queries and maximise collections.

Key Responsibilities:
- Proactively manage and collect outstanding client debt through telephone, email and written correspondence.
- Produce weekly aged debt reports, monitoring debtor performance and highlighting areas requiring attention.
- Work closely with fee earners to resolve account queries, accelerate collections and improve cash flow.
- Conduct account reconciliations, investigate payment discrepancies and escalate severely aged debt where necessary.
- Identify opportunities to improve collection processes, maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with internal credit control procedures.

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience in a Credit Control role, with a strong understanding of aged debt management and collection processes.
- Confident communicator with excellent telephone, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial information and produce meaningful reports.
- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and finance systems, with a proactive approach to improving processes. Experience within a legal or professional services environment would be advantageous but is not essential.

Please apply via the advert or contact John at Eclectic Recruitment for more information.

We endeavour to reply to every candidate, every time, but if you haven't heard back within 10 days, please understand that you have unfortunately been unsuccessful for this position, or the position has been filled. Please call the office or send an email to discuss other potential opportunities.

title: Credit Controller
description:
We are looking for a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Credit / Collections Controller to join our growing team at a well-established Business Services Company.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong collections skills, a keen eye for detail, and an interest in the legal and financial services sector.

Key Responsibilities:
- Regular professional liaison with customers to manage them through the collections process
- Setting up, negotiating and managing customer payment plans.
- Monitoring payment arrangements, following up with missed or broken plans and carrying out payment reviews.
- Maintaining accurate records and updating internal systems.
- Assisting with day-to-day legal and operational processes.
- Ensuring all work is completed accurately and within required deadlines.
- Providing administrative support to the legal team.
- Preparing, processing and maintaining legal documentation associated with court claims.
- Managing incoming and outgoing correspondence.
- Liaising with clients, creditors, solicitors and other relevant parties via email and telephone.

About You:
- Previous collections / credit control experience is essential.
- An understanding of legal administration / litigation relating to credit management or financial services experience would be advantageous.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (Accounts and Billing) Location: Watford (Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days working from home)
Contract Type: Temp to Perm
Availability: Immediately available candidates only
Salary Range: £32,000 to £35,000 per annum

Role Purpose
To support the day-to-day operation of the finance function through accurate transaction processing, reconciliations, customer billing, and collections. The role maintains accurate financial records, resolves routine queries, and supports the wider finance team, managing routine work independently with appropriate review and escalation of complex matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices, checking that the required approvals are in place and applying accurate nominal ledger coding.
- Process employee expenses, checking coding and uploading transactions into the finance system.
- Process credit card expenses, ensuring accurate nominal coding and application of established VAT treatments.
- Record bank receipts and payments in Sage, complete bank reconciliations, and investigate or escalate outstanding differences.
- Maintain subscription billing and collection records, ensuring that direct debit mandates in GoCardless and payment arrangements in Stripe align with invoices in the relevant billing systems, including Stripe, Naviga, and Xero.
- Monitor failed customer payments and follow the agreed process to resolve collection issues.
- Allocate customer receipts from the bank account to invoices in Naviga and investigate unallocated cash.
- Reconcile billing, payment-provider, and accounting records to bank receipts, investigating missing allocations, duplicate entries, and unexplained differences.
- Manage the finance inbox, responding to and resolving routine queries and referring matters to the appropriate colleague where required.
- Prepare national statistics survey responses, coordinating review of unusual definitions or matters requiring judgement.
- Maintain clear supporting records and follow up unresolved items to completion.
- Assist the wider finance team with duties and ad hoc projects consistent with the scope of the role.

Scope and Accountability
Manage routine processing, reconciliations, and queries independently within agreed procedures and deadlines. Escalate complex accounting or VAT matters and issues requiring approval to the appropriate finance colleague.
Person Specification
Essential Experience, Knowledge, and Skills
- Relevant practical finance experience covering purchase ledger, expenses, customer receipts, and bank reconciliations, with the ability to manage routine work with normal supervision.
- Sound working knowledge of bookkeeping, including double-entry principles and the relationship between invoices, credit notes, payments, receipts, and ledger balances.
- Experience investigating reconciliation differences, payment discrepancies, and unallocated receipts, with appropriate follow-up and escalation.
- Ability to apply established nominal and VAT coding and recognise transactions requiring technical review.
- Confidence comparing and reconciling data across accounting, billing, and payment systems.
- Practical Excel skills, including filters, lookups, SUMIFS, and duplicate checks.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to resolve queries with suppliers, customers, and colleagues.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation, and ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
- Sound judgement about when to resolve an issue independently and when to seek approval or technical support.

Qualifications
- AAT Level 3 completed or in progress, or equivalent practical knowledge and experience.

Desirable Experience and Skills
- Experience in a subscription or recurring billing environment.
- Experience using GoCardless or Stripe for collections and reconciliation.
- Experience using Sage or Xero, and familiarity with Naviga.
- Experience working across multiple finance or billing systems and following up failed payments.
- Experience completing Office for National Statistics surveys or similar business returns.
- Ability to use Excel pivot tables.

title: Part Time Accounts Assistant
description:
Part-Time Accounts Administrator

12 hours per week Flexible across 3 days Office based Permanent

Tate are recruiting for a successful, professional and privately owned SME looking to welcome a Part-Time Accounts Administrator to its finance team.

Interviews are starting now, with a view to an early January start.

The role will initially be 12 hours per week, with the potential for the hours to increase as the business becomes busier.

There is good flexibility around the working pattern. Monday will need to be included, but the remaining days can be discussed. A pattern of 4 hours per day across 3 days could work particularly well.

The role

Working alongside the Bookkeeper, you will support the smooth day-to-day running of the accounts function, including:
- Processing supplier and overhead invoices
- Supporting purchase and sales ledger activity
- Preparing information for bank reconciliations
- Reconciling supplier statements
- Matching remittances and payments
- Chasing missing invoices and receipts
- Processing staff expenses
- Recording VAT and CIS information
- Processing purchase orders and subcontractor invoices
- Preparing customer invoices
- Responding to supplier and customer invoice queries
- Maintaining accurate finance records
- Supporting general finance and office administration

The company processes its accounts using Xero, so previous Xero experience would be particularly helpful. Knowledge of simPRO would also be advantageous, but not essential.

About you!

We are looking for someone with previous accounts, bookkeeping or finance administration experience who is:
- Accurate and detail-focused
- Organised and methodical
- Confident with numbers
- Comfortable managing routine deadlines
- A clear communicator and a helpful team mate
- Discreet with confidential information

This is an office-based role, with roadside parking available within the vicinity of the office.

If you are looking for a routine part-time accounts opportunity that can give you stability and scope for the hours to grow in the future, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now for consideration for interviews taking place this side of Christmas ready for a January start.

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

Central to Bishops Stortford

title: Payroll Officer
description:
VolkerWessels UK is a market leading contracting group of five closely linked businesses.

We provide integrated and ground-breaking solutions for the civil engineering and construction sectors, with specialisms in rail, highways, airports, marine, defence, energy, water, and environmental infrastructure.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Officer to join our team on a 1-year fixed term contract. Reporting to the Payroll Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the accurate and timely processing of both our weekly and monthly payrolls while maintaining compliance with statutory legislation and company policies.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced payroll professional seeking a flexible, part-time role within a supportive team environment.

Please note that this role is an office-based role at our Hoddesdon head office. This is a 1 year maternity cover fixed term contract, Part time working 26.5 hours per week.

About our role
- Process weekly and monthly payrolls accurately and on time.
- Prepare, input, and process payroll data for allocated payrolls.
- Check and reconcile payroll outputs prior to BACS submission.
- Review payrolls processed by other team members to help ensure BACS deadlines are met.
- Respond to employee payroll queries in an efficient, professional, and confidential manner.
- Liaise with internal departments to ensure payroll information is received within required deadlines.
- Support the Payroll Manager and wider payroll team with ad-hoc duties and projects as required.

About you
- Demonstrable payroll experience.
- A good understanding of statutory payroll legislation.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
- Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
- Experience processing manual payroll calculations.
- Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage deadlines effectively.

If your past experience doesn't match perfectly with every requirement of the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for us.

Why work with us?

VolkerWessels UK operate through five separate, but complementary businesses, working in collaboration and using our specialist skills to deliver an integrated service for our clients. At any one time, our people are working on our sites or in our offices, for around 250 projects across the UK. Everyday we overcome challenges, fulfilling our commitments, no matter what. That's what our business is about, that's how our people find satisfaction in their jobs.

We offer competitive rewards and benefits, recognising the value we place on our employees.

We offer a range of benefits, including:
